title: In vivo evaluation of α-glucosidase inhibition using Drosophila
author: Wongchum, Tanomtong, et al.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Make a 50 mM potassium phosphate buffer (pH 7.0 at 25 °C) by mixing dibasic and monobasic stock solutions and adjusting the volume and pH.

substeps.instruction: Add 6.15 mL of 1.0 M potassium phosphate dibasic solution to a beaker.
Add 3.85 mL of 1.0 M potassium phosphate monobasic solution to the same beaker.
Add ultrapure water to bring the total volume to 200 mL.
Adjust the pH to 7.0 at 25 °C using 1 M KOH or 1 M HCl.

steps.title: Prepare high‑sugar diet (30 % sucrose)
steps.instruction: Create a 30 % (w/v) sucrose solution to be used as the high‑sugar diet for Drosophila.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 30 g of sucrose and place it in a volumetric flask.
Add sterile water and bring the final volume to 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 100 M acarbose stock diet
steps.instruction: Make a 100 M acarbose solution in the 30 % sucrose diet as a stock for subsequent dilutions.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.0065 g acarbose (MW = 645.604 g·mol⁻¹) and add it to a volumetric flask.
Fill the flask with the 30 % sucrose solution prepared above and bring the volume to 100 mL.

steps.title: Generate acarbose concentration series
steps.instruction: Dilute the 100 M acarbose stock to obtain the required test concentrations using the C1V1 = C2V2 relationship.

substeps.instruction: Prepare solutions of acarbose at 5 M, 2.5 M, 1.25 M, 0.625 M, 0.3125 M, 0.156 M, and 0.078 M by calculating the appropriate volumes of stock and diluent (30 % sucrose solution).

steps.title: Feed Drosophila experimental diets
steps.instruction: Expose wild‑type female D. melanogaster (Oregon‑R‑C, 8–10 days old) to the prepared diets for the α‑glucosidase assay.

substeps.instruction: Place 20 flies per vial (total N = 100 per condition).
Assign vials to the following diet groups: 30 % sucrose (induction), 6 % sucrose (negative control), and each acarbose concentration (test groups).
Allow flies to feed for the duration required by the assay (as described in the study).

steps.title: Determine IC₅₀ for acarbose
steps.instruction: Calculate the IC₅₀ value for acarbose‑mediated α‑glucosidase inhibition using the assay data.

substeps.instruction: Analyze the activity measurements from the 100 flies (20 per vial) across the concentration series.
